text: Swimming, often measured by laps, involves rhythmic movement and goggles for protection. Splashing adds enjoyment and exercise, making it a popular and therapeutic form of physical activity. The rhythmic movement of swimming helps improve cardiovascular health and builds muscle strength, especially in the upper body. Many enjoy swimming as a hobby or competitive sport, whether in pools or open water. Swimmers often use goggles to protect their eyes from water and enhance their visibility, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience.
summary: Swimming, often measured by laps, involves rhythmic movement and goggles for protection. Splashing adds enjoyment and exercise.
